concerns.text: FR-003 requires CLR transformation for *all* downstream analyses, yet DESeq2 (T011) is run on raw counts, violating the compositional‑data principle.
FR-005 / SC-003 mandate Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction for association results, but no explicit task applies the correction before schema validation.
SC-006 requires reporting the overall cross‑cohort replication *rate* as a percentage, but T012 only flags per‑taxon replication without computing the aggregate rate.
SC-007 specifies that the unified harmonized dataset must contain ≥ 1,000 samples, yet no task verifies or asserts this sample‑size threshold.
All task tags use the form `[US1]`, `[US2]`, etc., which do not match the spec IDs `[US-1]`, `[US-2]`, etc.; these stale tags break traceability to the user stories.
